target_fidelity.rationale: Corroborating changes in scoring and advance access provides an explicitly bounded contribution to establishing whether the award was steered. The inference leaves unresolved steering allegations open rather than treating corroborated features as proof of steering.

operational_coherence.rationale: Comparing available tender documents, panel interviews and email exports while checking provenance can reveal independent agreement or conflict on material allegations. Credible independent convergence warrants increased support for those features within the stated limits.

validity.rationale: All three criteria pass: the mapping preserves corroboration and its limits, provides a bounded contribution to the retained question, and supports an intelligible operational inference.

uncertainty: The packet supplies no comparison results, so it establishes neither which allegations are corroborated nor whether steering occurred.
